normal.caption_source: The healthy cornea of a 24 year old male (cross-section view). Corneal epithelium, stroma, and endothelium can be clearly seen. Below, a pachymetry map has been calculated from other cross-section data on the same cornea. Central corneal thickness in this patient is lower than average.
